query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unpredictable solids discharge in our hydrocyclone. Develop a comprehensive diagnostic framework to identify potential root causes.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Create a detailed diagnostic framework to investigate the root causes of inconsistent solids discharge from a hydrocyclone, including potential operational and design factors.

selected_agents.role: Root cause investigation and diagnostic framework development
Hydrocyclone process analysis and performance evaluation
Operational parameter analysis and control system assessment

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative diagnostic process and performance data analysis

clarification_questions: What is the typical particle size distribution of the solids being processed?
What are the current operating parameters of the hydrocyclone (flow rate, pressure, etc.)?
Have there been any recent changes in the feed material or operating conditions?
